items.title: Audit: enumerate CLI paths that commit to / mutate the main branch or worktree and flag any not under the main-write-lock
items.context: Grep for git commit / merge / update-ref / branch ops and metadata-on-main writes across packages/main/src (handlers + cli-engine + core); cross-reference against withMainWriteLock/withReentrantMainWriteLock usage. Produce the list of main-mutating paths and which are NOT locked (B-7365's reconcile is now locked; find any others).
items.userSees: The audit output lists every main-mutating CLI path and marks which hold the main-write-lock and which (if any) still do not.

items.title: Close the gaps: wrap any remaining unlocked main-mutating path in withReentrantMainWriteLock
items.context: For each unlocked main-mutating path found in the audit, wrap its main commit/merge/ref-update critical section in withReentrantMainWriteLock (reentrant, since some run within already-locked contexts). If the audit finds none remaining, record that and proceed to the guard. Do not change command semantics; lock-only.
items.userSees: Each previously-unlocked main-mutating path now acquires the main-write-lock; concurrent sessions are serialized on those paths (no race corruption).

items.title: Regression guard + tests: mechanically flag any main-mutating commit path not under the lock
items.context: Add a test/guard (e.g. a static scan or a runtime assertion test) that fails if a CLI path commits to main without holding the lock, so a future B-7365-class gap is caught mechanically rather than by convention. Cover the gaps found and a negative case.
items.userSees: lattice validate green with a regression guard that turns red if a new main-mutating path is added without the main-write-lock.
